import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static long calculate(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        long prefix = 0, digits = 0;
        while (prefix * 10 + 1 <= n) {
            prefix = prefix * 10 + 1;
            ++digits;
        }
        long first_option = digits * (n / prefix) + calculate(n % prefix);
        long second_option = digits + 1;
        n = 10 * prefix + 1 - n;
        second_option += digits * (n / prefix) + calculate(n % prefix);
        return Math.min(first_option, second_option);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long input_value = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(calculate(input_value));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
